scope.contract: Corrected Algorithm3 TS chains in each original183 case, checked in the eight-scheme composite with six unaffected chains and original1000 channel-moment proof/source reuse.
scope.independent_math: MP80/MP100 saved own-state physical/QT/preP7/channel/phase-gradient/domain/original-stop checks and complete mu/strict-PhiStar/signed-power-stop guard sequence, as accepted by the frozen auditors.
scope.accepted_design_vs_returned_rejected_att: Per-case accepted-design PASS preserves returned/rejected numeric guard attempts and does not assert every rejected attempt passed. Their full attempt counts are not embedded in these aggregate projections.
scope.count_semantics: Producer field names/values are retained as recorded. Counts describe saved recorder artifacts, including reused cases; they are not counts of new optimization work and not every hidden inner iterate. Missing fields are omitted, never filled from another case.
scope.current_capsule_data_scope: Actual gates, artifact digests and stored counts from closed aggregates. Full183 performance is packaged separately; RAW/MAT operands and individual MP bodies are not copied here. No absence of retained performance data is claimed.
scope.record_flag_projection: Keep the actual scoped passed flags, selected recorded producer/check fields and stored natural exit codes; no default true retention-policy field is inferred for individual records.

historical_reader_failure.root_cause: Stale producer snapshot followed by querying an already naturally closed producer PID; retained host/lifecycle failure, not a recorded numerical failure.
historical_reader_failure.old_source_scope: Outer14 covered inner11; no inner-after interval fabricated for the failed reader.
